label: Lombok
short_description: Loyalty-program beach resorts across Lombok, from the Senggigi coast to the northwest and the Mandalika-area south.
intro: Lombok's hotels in this directory are beach resorts spread around the island east of Bali: the Senggigi strip on the west coast, the quieter northwest near Sira and the Gili islands, and design-led stays toward the south. Backed by Mount Rinjani and quieter than neighbouring Bali, Lombok suits beach-and-nature stays; the island is reached via Lombok International Airport (LOP) in the south.
